caption: Global size 8 with local size 4: the column number is the global id, and the eight work-items split into two work-groups of four, each numbering its own local ids 0–3. Every work-item i computes C[i] = A[i] + B[i], so work-item 6 sits in group 1 at local id 2 and gives C[6] = 7 + 10 = 17.

spec.title: NDRange: global size 8, local size 4
spec.aria: An eight-cell one-dimensional NDRange with global ids 0 to 7, split into work-group 0 (global ids 0 to 3) and work-group 1 (global ids 4 to 7), each with local ids 0 to 3, and rows A, B, C showing work-item 6 computing C[6] = 7 + 10 = 17.
